lead.title: OpenAI announces GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra and Luna models launching July 10
lead.summary: OpenAI unveiled GPT-5.6 Sol, its next-generation flagship model, along with specialized variants Terra and Luna for targeted domains. Global preview access is expanding now ahead of the public launch on Thursday, marking the company's most significant model release since GPT-5.

top_stories.title: OpenAI introduces GPT-Live, a full-duplex voice model for natural conversation
top_stories.summary: A new generation of voice AI that listens and speaks simultaneously, rolling out to ChatGPT on iOS, Android, and web with API support coming soon.

top_stories.title: xAI launches Grok 4.5 as its smartest model yet, rivals GPT-5.5 at 1/5 the cost
top_stories.summary: Trained on tens of thousands of NVIDIA GB300 GPUs with large-scale RL, served at 80 TPS, and priced at $2/M input and $6/M output tokens. Available in Grok Build, Cursor, and the SpaceXAI API.

top_stories.title: SambaNova raises $1B at $11B valuation in Series F first close
top_stories.summary: The AI chip maker for enterprise inference infrastructure drew a $1 billion round led by General Atlantic with Intel participating.

top_stories.title: Anthropic expands Claude Cowork to mobile and web in beta launch
top_stories.summary: Claude Cowork moves beyond desktop to iOS, Android, and web. Sessions run in the cloud by default, span devices, and continue even when the laptop is closed. Available to Max subscribers first.

items.title: Gemma 4 Technical Report: Google's open-weight multimodal LLMs set new SOTA
items.summary: Google introduces open-weight multimodal LLMs (2.3B-31B, dense + MoE) with thinking mode, encoder-free 12B architecture, and KV-cache optimizations, establishing SOTA on STEM, multimodal, and long-context benchmarks.

items.title: Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion: NVIDIA unifies autoregressive, diffusion and self-speculation decoding
items.summary: NVIDIA's tri-mode LM at 8B scale decodes 6x more tokens per forward than Qwen3-8B with comparable accuracy, delivering 4x higher throughput on SPEED-Bench.

items.title: SenseNova-Vision: All CV tasks reformulated as unified multimodal generation
items.summary: Formulates detection, segmentation, depth, keypoints and pose as multimodal generation within a single UMM without task-specific heads, matching specialized systems across diverse vision benchmarks.

items.title: RynnWorld-4D: Alibaba's 4D embodied world model for robotic manipulation
items.summary: Jointly predicts synchronized RGB, depth and optical flow from a single RGB-D image and language instruction. Features a tri-branch Diffusion Transformer enabling >9 Hz closed-loop bimanual control.

items.title: Flex-Forcing: NVIDIA unifies autoregressive and bidirectional video diffusion
items.summary: A unified video diffusion framework enabling flexible generation with both forward and bidirectional conditioning in a single architecture.

items.title: Grok 4.5 rivals GPT-5.5, outperforms Opus 4.8 at 1/5 the price
items.summary: Analysis from Theo — t3.gg benchmarks Grok 4.5 against leading models, showing competitive performance at a fraction of the cost with significantly better token efficiency.

items.title: OpenAI expands GPT-5.6 release globally after Trump administration approval
items.summary: Bloomberg's AI editor reports on the global rollout of OpenAI's most advanced model following regulatory clearance.

items.title: Bank of America reverses course, extends $520M credit line to OpenAI
items.summary: Bloomberg sources reveal BofA is now extending a $520 million credit line to OpenAI after initially passing on the opportunity, signaling growing financial confidence.

items.title: ZML/LLMD: Free inference server runs open-weight models across Nvidia, AMD, Apple and Intel chips
items.summary: French AI startup ZML released a free LLM inference server supporting multi-chip deployment (Nvidia, AMD, Google TPU, Apple Metal, Intel Arc), promising maximum performance without vendor lock-in.

items.title: Rowboat: Open-source, local-first alternative to Claude Desktop with memory
items.summary: An AI coworker with dedicated work surfaces for email, meetings, notes, browser, and coding. Reached #2 on Show HN with 168 points.

items.title: Halo: Open-source, tamper-evident runtime evidence for AI agents
items.summary: Generates verifiable audit trails proving what an agent did with data, aiming to solve the compliance and trust gap in the post-agentic enterprise.

items.title: Framer launches AI Agents for design and publishing on the canvas
items.summary: AI-powered design, writing, analysis, and organization tools on the Framer canvas, plus branching for safer team collaboration.

items.title: Universal-3.5 Pro: AssemblyAI's most accurate speech-to-text model
items.summary: Targets high-accuracy transcription use cases across multiple languages and domains with improved precision.
